name: Mnemonic 126M
about: 16 layers, pretrained on 5B tokens of FineWeb-Edu, then tuned for chat on smol-smoltalk. int8 weights: the same quality as full precision at a quarter of the size.

name: Mnemonic 126M, small download
about: The same model with int4 weights. A 40% smaller download and a little faster, but noticeably less sharp.
